name: Me & Younger Me
context: Creative AI home assignment / professional evaluation project.
summary: A multi-scene generative AI concept built around creating believable interactions between an adult subject and a younger version of the same person while maintaining identity and scene consistency across images and video.
challenge: Create a coherent visual story in which two age-separated versions of the same identity appear naturally together across multiple scenes, while solving consistency, composition and controllability problems inherent to generative image workflows.
objectives: Maintain recognizable identity across age-separated character versions.
Create multiple coherent scenes rather than a single generated image.
Use controllable AI workflows rather than relying only on prompt-based generation.

process.title: Concept and scene definition
process.description: Defined a set of interactions between an adult and younger version of the same identity, including remembered scenes such as 1990s-style gaming, dancing and a pillow fight.

process.title: Identity and character consistency
process.description: Used a custom ComfyUI-based workflow with IPAdapter-related techniques to preserve identity and visual continuity across generated scenes.

process.title: Composition and spatial control
process.description: Used depth guidance and iterative generation to improve pose, placement and interaction between characters.

process.title: Multi-scene generation
process.description: Produced multiple scenes while working to keep the characters visually coherent across different actions and environments.

process.title: Image-to-video extension
process.description: Extended selected visual outputs into motion as part of the final creative AI workflow.

outcomes: Created a coherent multi-scene creative concept using a custom generative AI workflow.
Demonstrated hands-on control over identity consistency, composition and image-to-video production.

presentation.short_pitch: A custom AI-native workflow for creating consistent multi-scene interactions between an adult and a younger version of the same identity.
presentation.long_pitch: This project demonstrates an AI-native design process rather than prompt-only generation: concept definition, identity consistency, spatial control, multi-scene iteration and image-to-video production were treated as one connected creative workflow.
